_doc: CVS configuration - single source of truth. Weights are relative; null factors redistribute among present ones and confidence reports the covered share. z_point_scale converts one weighted z-unit of non-projection factors into VOR points so every Explain row reads in points. Walter judgment deltas are percentages of CVS, clamped to walter_cap_pct total; inferred tags count at inferred_multiplier. Changing any value recomputes the board - nothing else in the app reads these numbers.
_null_notes: historical_priors is null for every player today (no age or draft-capital factor is wired at player level); its weight redistributes and confidence reflects it. schedule uses prior-season defense, a weak predictor, priced by its low weight.
